newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Q3 GDP grows 6.4 pct vs 9.8 pct year ago.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Q3 GDP grows 6.4 pct vs 9.8 pct year ago.

text.p: South Korea's gross domestic product (GDP) grew a real 6.4 percent in the third quarter of 1996 against a 9.8 percent rise a year earlier, provisional figures of the Bank of Korea (BOK) showed on Thursday
NOTE - Growth figures in percent and value in trillions of won.
An official at the BOK, the central bank, said the sectors of agriculture, forestry and fishing, services and construction showed a dramatic slowdown in the third quarter.
He said private-sector consumption, investment and exports had all slowed in the third quarter.
Private consumption rose 6.0 percent, against an 8.0 percent rise a year earlier and a 7.1 percent rise in the second quarter, the central bank figures showed.
"Falling export prices reduced consumers' purchasing power," said the BOK official said.
Capital investment in the third quarter rose a year-on-year 8.7 percent, compared with a rise of 22.2 percent a year ago.
Construction investment increased 4.7 percent against a 10.8 percent rise a year earlier, the BOK said.
Third-quarter exports rose 9.4 percent, compared with 28.3 percent a year before, while imports rose 11.7 percent against 25.2 percent.
